posts.title_en: crumb.gg's patch digest: the 1.4.002 hotfix and update 1.5.002 (upcoming 2026-10-08)
posts.summary_en: The digest answered 200 on 2026-10-07 and adds two entries since the first round. A 1.4.002 hotfix (undated in the digest; the official notice is nv:48486, 10-02): auto-bake 200/300/400/500 at oven 32/34/36/38, auto-bake stops at 100 unsold gear (was 30), Arena defender protection 6 days → 10 minutes, Rift boss summons count for missions. Update 1.5.002, flagged upcoming, release 2026-10-08 16:00 KST: max cookie level 100 → 120; EXP for Lv.79–100 lowered (Lv.100 13,911,155 → 3,347,644); Gnome Lab research time capped at 12 hours (rows 73–110, 51 nodes); Gnome Lab to research 130-2 and special 22; main stages to 364-30; mileage exchange adds Chocosteel ×5 for 1,500 mileage and Metal Syrup ×5 for 2,000 mileage; the Dimension Fragment (Rift) exchange's limits on Chocosteel ×5 and Metal Syrup ×2 rise from 5 to 10; a 7-day check-in with Milk Cookie's Crunchy Strong Pediatrician; the new SSR Chardonnay with base ATK 133 / DEF 60 / HP 2,790 and level-120 10★ stats ATK 14,202 / DEF 3,247 / HP 297,958. No balance change to existing cookies or pets.
